transcript.text: I'd never made more than $3 million a
year until I met my wife. 24 months
after that, I took home over $17 million
in personal income. Never stifle a
generous impulse. Whether it's a gift or
praise, the moment you think it, send
it. Stress doesn't mean there's anything
wrong. It just means that you're alive.
Be fast to extend trust and even faster
to take it back. You never regret taking
a night to sleep on an emotional
response, but you do regret the ones
that you take in the moment. You cannot
ask anyone for things that you have not
already given them. Be fiercely
competitive with yourself and ignore
everyone else. Listen to feedback the
first time. If it makes you better,
change it now, no matter how much it
hurts. Do what you're most afraid of
because it's usually the thing that you
need to do the most. You cannot be CEO
of more than one thing. Saying no to
everything means saying yes to the one
thing that matters most.
